description: Somos un equipo apasionado de estudiantes de ingeniería entusiasmados por el reto de transformar ideas científicas complejas en juegos creativos y dinamicos.
summary:
Space Odyssey: Mission Commander is an educational and interactive web game that allows anyone to experience the challenges of leading a space mission using real\-world concepts, orbital mechanics, and NASA\-inspired scientific data.

Players take on the role of a mission commander, choosing a destination, planning trajectories, assembling spacecraft, selecting launch vehicles, and responding to unexpected events throughout the mission. As the journey progresses, players must manage resources, solve technical failures under time pressure, and complete scientific objectives to ensure mission success.

The project was designed to make space exploration more accessible and engaging by transforming complex aerospace concepts into an immersive experience. Rather than simply learning about space missions, players actively participate in them, experiencing the decision\-making, responsibility, and operational pressure faced by real mission teams.

By combining education, gameplay, and scientific accuracy, Space Odyssey aims to inspire curiosity about space exploration while helping players understand the engineering, planning, and problem\-solving behind modern space missions.
